texts: Why did Coraline Ash write in her log that a crowd of nightmoths brings sky-cats down from the cliff-spires?

q1_issues.issue: "in her log" is slotted as (Location $w $lg), but the log is the medium the writing was recorded in rather than a place, and the instruction set routes exactly this case ("in a statement" likewise In) to the preposition-named oblique (In <event> <object>).

q2_gaps: closed-spelling compound ("nightmoths"): the solid-spelling rule fixes that the genus atom is emitted but not whether the compound symbol keeps the solid form (nightmoth) or is split into modifier_noun (night_moth), so two faithful parses of the same word need not produce the same symbol
review.notes: Everything else matches: Experiencer on the sealing speech verb, the whole complement sealed under Theme with the indefinite crowd kept inside, the definite "the cliff-spires" GroupOf typing and the compound-kind decomposition atoms projected outside the seal, phrasal bring_down with no genus, and ReasonFor on the matrix writing event.

issues.reason: The medium half stands — the nearest named precedent ("in a statement" likewise In) favours the preposition-named oblique, so an In-stored writing and this Location query would not unify — but the claim that the instruction set routes this case does not: Location is its own head for an "in / at / on" PP answering where on an event, and a log is a physical thing written in, so the atom is neither false nor ill-typed and the head choice for a written medium is undecided.

gaps_confirmed: a transparently modifier+head SOLID spelling ("nightmoths"): the instruction set fixes that the genus atom is emitted but never fixes whether the compound symbol keeps the solid form (nightmoth) or splits into modifier_noun (night_moth), so two faithful parses of one word can differ
new_gaps: "write / record in <document>": the head for a written MEDIUM is undecided — the event-role Location ("in/at/on" answering where) and the preposition-named In (the "in a statement" precedent) both fit and nothing selects between them, so a statement and its question can store one fact two ways
adjudication.notes: The rest is on-spec: Experiencer on the sealing write, the whole complement sealed under Theme with the indefinite crowd kept inside, definite typing and compound-genus decomposition atoms projected outside the seal, phrasal bring_down with no genus, and the single ReasonFor conjunct on the matrix event.
